name: GPA Calculator
summary: Compute a weighted 4.0 GPA from course credits and letter grades — locally.
description: Add courses with credit hours and letter grades (A through F, including plus/minus). See GPA, total credits, and quality points using a common US 4.0 scale. Schools vary — verify against your registrar.

faqs.question: Will this match my school’s GPA?
faqs.answer: Not always. Institutions use different plus/minus maps and weighting rules. Confirm with your registrar.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Calculations run entirely in your browser.
